project_name: Coffee Atlas – Discover the World of Coffee
archetype: ARCHETYPE 5: LUXURY with Organic & Earthy undertones. Deep, cinematic, and moody.

typography.primary_usage: Main headings, hero text, and large numbers. Elegant, high-contrast serif. Weight: 400, 600.
typography.secondary_usage: Body text, UI elements, data meters, navigation. Clean geometric sans-serif for readability. Weight: 300, 400, 500.
typography.accent_usage: Editorial accents, subtitles, pull quotes. Often used in italic (font-style: italic).

scales.small_label: text-xs md:text-sm tracking-[0.2em] uppercase font-semibold text-latte

visual_enhancers.glassmorphism: Use backdrop-blur-xl or backdrop-blur-2xl with bg-espresso/40. MUST have a 1px border of border-cream/10 to create the 'milled crystal' edge. Never use flat muddy transparency.
visual_enhancers.shadows: Soft, diffused ambient glow. shadow-[0_8px_32px_rgba(200,154,71,0.05)] for floating cards.
visual_enhancers.textures: Background should have a very subtle SVG noise/grain overlay (fixed, opacity 5-10%, pointer-events-none) to remove digital flatness and make it feel like film.
visual_enhancers.depth: Layering: Background (Grain) -> Particles (floating bokeh/steam via framer-motion) -> Content -> Floating Glass Cards.

layouts.spacing_philosophy: Generous. Use massive vertical padding between sections (py-24 md:py-32). Tension through asymmetry.
layouts.bento_grid: Grid items must use span logic to create asymmetry. Example: 1 tall card, 2 square cards, 1 wide horizontal card. gap-6 or gap-8.

motion.smooth_scroll: Lenis MUST be used for standard smooth scrolling to give the site weight and momentum.
motion.hero_reveal: Kinetic typography. Masked line-by-line reveal using Framer Motion (initial Y offset, hidden overflow, animate to 0).
motion.parallax: Use Framer Motion useScroll and useTransform for subtle image parallax and floating background beans/steam particles.
motion.micro_interactions: Hover states on cards: slight scale up (scale-105), tilt effect, border glow intensifies. Buttons should have magnetic tracking if possible, or elegant fill transitions.
motion.marquee: Slow editorial marquee for transition sections. 'Aroma — Body — Acidity — Flavor —' using Cormorant Garamond italic.

Navigation.style: Sticky at top (top-0 z-50), crystal glassmorphism (backdrop-blur-2xl bg-dark_roast/70 border-b border-cream/10).
Navigation.content: Logo left, Nav links center (hidden on mobile), CTA right.

Hero.layout: Massive typography 'Explore The World Of Coffee', subtitle 'Every cup tells a story...'. Background is a dark moody cinematic image with a vignette overlay.
Hero.motion: On-load masked text reveal. Background image scales down slightly over 3 seconds (scale 1.1 -> 1.0) on load.

Editorial_Marquee.content: A slow, elegant scrolling text strip.
Editorial_Marquee.style: bg-espresso text-latte text-5xl md:text-7xl py-6 border-y border-gold/20

Coffee_Types.layout: Bento Grid of floating glass cards. Each card contains image, title, origin, and custom meters (strength, milk, bitterness, caffeine).
Coffee_Types.meters: Progress bars using the Gold or Latte colors, background espresso/50.

Coffee_Modal_Page.layout: Detailed view. Can be a full-screen Framer Motion modal or separate page route. 50/50 split (image left, scrolling content right).
Coffee_Modal_Page.content: History, origin, taste notes, ingredients, recipe ratios, calories.

History_Timeline.layout: Vertical line down the center. Alternating left/right content blocks.
History_Timeline.motion: Use InView from Framer Motion to draw the line and fade in content blocks as user scrolls.

Interactive_Map.style: Dark mode SVG map. Interactive dots (Gold/Emerald) pulsing.
Interactive_Map.content: Brazil, Colombia, Ethiopia, Vietnam, India, Italy, Turkey. Hover reveals region details.

Brewing_Methods.layout: Horizontal scroll or Masonry layout. Cards with sleek product photography.

Recipes.layout: Step-by-step accordion (Shadcn Accordion customized) or vertical numbered list. High contrast numbering.

Stats_Counters.layout: Grid of large numbers (Playfair Display) counting up when in view.
Stats_Counters.motion: Framer motion animate from 0 to target value.

Gallery.layout: Pinterest-style Masonry. Images have no gaps or very tight gaps (gap-2), hover reveals captions with glass overlay.

Testimonials.layout: Glass cards, 5-star icons (Gold). Subtle floating animation on the cards (y-axis sine wave motion).

Footer.style: bg-dark_roast pt-32 pb-12. Massive logo typography.
Footer.content: Newsletter form (custom Shadcn input), social links, standard links.

hero_cinematic.description: Dark moody espresso pouring. Perfect for the hero background.

brewing_alternative.description: White ceramic cup on wooden table. Great for brewing or recipes section.

beans_macro.description: Macro shot of roasted beans. Use as textured background element or in coffee types.

coffee_cherries.description: Red coffee cherries on branch. Perfect for the history or origin map section.

farm_landscape.description: Misty coffee farm landscape. Ideal for the Origins/World of Coffee introductory block.

espresso_machine.description: Espresso machine macro. Use in brewing methods section.

instructions_to_main_agent.1: You MUST NOT apply universal transition (`transition: all`). Always add transitions for specific interactive elements.
instructions_to_main_agent.2: Never use pure #000000. Use the provided #1A1612 (dark_roast) as the deepest black.
instructions_to_main_agent.3: Every glass container must have a 1px border (`border-cream/10` or similar) to ensure the crystal aesthetic.
instructions_to_main_agent.4: Install and use `lucide-react` for any necessary icons. Install `framer-motion` for all complex animations.
instructions_to_main_agent.5: Do not center align the entire app container. Maintain left alignment for text to preserve editorial readability.
instructions_to_main_agent.6: Use the provided image URLs exclusively. DO NOT use placeholder services like via.placeholder.com.
instructions_to_main_agent.7: All interactive and key informational elements MUST include a `data-testid` attribute (e.g., `data-testid="coffee-type-card"`).
instructions_to_main_agent.8: Implement a custom Lenis scroll wrapper component to ensure smooth momentum scrolling across the entire site.

UNIVERSAL_GUIDELINES_FOR_MAIN_AGENT: Prioritize optical alignment over geometric alignment.
Ensure high contrast for text (APCA standard).
Avoid generic centered layouts, simplistic gradients, and uniform styling.
Create depth through layered design elements with z-index hierarchy and backdrop filters.
Implement micro-animations on all interactive elements (hover states, transitions).
